title: ChatCRM
deck: A shared WhatsApp inbox where every conversation is assigned to an agent and becomes a customer you can measure.

title: Tribu
deck: Issue electronic payment documents to SUNAT from TypeScript in one call: no XML to write, no IGV to compute, no SUNAT codes to type.

title: assess (ax)
deck: Classroom exams from a single laptop. The teacher supervises in the terminal; students answer from any browser on the local network. No installs, no accounts, no internet.

title: Lumio
deck: A transparent electricity-bill calculator: turns kWh into soles and soles into kWh, itemises every charge and runs entirely in the browser.

title: Reproducible research
deck: A paper monorepo where every figure comes from a versioned pipeline. If a result does not reproduce, it does not go into the manuscript.
